definition.fee+half_spread: move - half a tick (bp at the pre-move mid) >= 1.7 bp
definition.grid_moves: nonzero |log return| of the implied mid, per hourly file
definition.model_snipeable: lambda_j * exp(-h/b) from jump_fit_v2.json at each horizon
definition.move: log move, in the race's direction, from the implied mid of the last record before the race's first ms to the furthest implied mid the race's own records reach
definition.move_episodes: the same clusters with no minimum record count
definition.operating_point_moves: rate of moves >= h over each grid horizon in the model as run: the 10 ms fit's jumps plus diffusion
definition.race: race_proxy.py's race (upper bound) and >=2-stamp race (lower bound)

exploratory: Not pre-registered; not a test of any pre-registered prediction. Written to qualify the race-gap limitation.
